ask: Call a number to cancel and get a refund

message.subject: Your antivirus renewed for $399 - call to cancel
message.body: Your antivirus renewed for $399 today. If this is a mistake, call this number now to cancel and get a refund.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Norton.
reasons: The refund call ends with remote access to the computer.
The sender's address is not the company's.
